title: Hospital reprimands Italo for filming the room with James Fox
place_text: Maternity ward, regional hospital, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: No, they just prohibited me from filming inside. And that's right, because once I filmed, I went into the maternity ward with James in the room where it was.

plain: Italo Venturelli, a surgeon in Varginha, Brazil, says his hospital once operated on an alien. He says that around 2023 he took the documentary filmmaker James Fox into the hospital's maternity ward and filmed the room where it had been, and that afterwards the hospital banned him from filming inside. He says he thinks the ban was fair.
